end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group to estimate a larger collection and deciding whether an estimate was close to the actual number. Ananya explained that an estimate is a guess or andaza, and later used 10 peanuts three times to reach 30 and identify it as close to 32. An early mix-up treated three handfuls as 3 objects, but this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, use small groups of buttons or beans: count one group, make several similar groups, estimate the total, then compare it with the actual count.
